academics.question: attendance requirements
academics.answer: Students must maintain a strict minimum of 75% attendance across all theory and laboratory courses to be eligible for mid-term and semester-end examinations.

academics.question: biometric logging
academics.answer: Mandatory biometric attendance logging is enforced daily between 8:30 AM to 9:00 AM and evening departure at 4:10 PM sharp.

hostel.question: hostel outing guide
hostel.answer: Outing applications must be submitted via the portal 24 hours prior. Automated IVRS confirmation calls are triggered to parents, and approval is mandatory.

hostel.question: mess timings and food
hostel.answer: Mess serving hours: Breakfast (7:30 AM - 9:30 AM), Lunch (12:00 PM - 2:00 PM), Snacks (4:30 PM - 5:30 PM), and Dinner (7:30 PM - 9:30 PM).

placements.question: placement stats (2021-2026)
placements.answer:

• 2023 Batch: 810+ Offers (Highest: 44 LPA, Avg: 5.2 LPA)

• 2025 Batch: 830+ Offers (Highest: 42 LPA, Avg: 5.5 LPA)
• 2026 Batch: 500+ Offers secured with Amazon, TCS, Wipro, ServiceNow.

library.question: central library timings
library.answer: Open from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM on working days and 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM on Saturdays. Houses over 55,000 volumes and digital journals.

examination.question: examination structure
examination.answer: Autonomous semester system with two mid-term exams (30 marks) and end-semester external examinations (70 marks).

fee.question: fee counter details
fee.answer: Located on the ground floor of the main administrative block. Open from 9:30 AM to 4:00 PM on working days.

it_support.question: it and wi-fi support
it_support.answer: High-speed campus Wi-Fi is accessible to all students. Configure devices by logging into the IT portal using your roll number.
